value.rationale: The model is motivated by robustness of stable allocations under noisy preference reporting. It reveals exact event-level independence in a sequential allocation with endogenous remaining sets, and the nonzero limiting survival fraction e^{-1/2} when every participating agent experiences a preference perturbation. The result is an all-population law with systemic interpretation, not an arbitrary one-off enumeration.
